children: The recognitions will honour young sustainability leaders and organisations driving measurable impact across decarbonisation, clean energy, circularity and climate resilience

BW Businessworld will felicitate the winners of the BW Sustainability 40 Under 40 and the BW Sustainable World Awards 2026 tomorrow, 17  September 2026, at the Novotel, Andheri, as part of the 9th Sustainable World Conclave. The recognitions will spotlight young leaders and organisations driving India's sustainability agenda forward, from decarbonisation and clean energy to circularity and climate-resilient supply chains.

The BW Sustainability 40 Under 40 winners will be felicitated across three dedicated segments through the day, recognising professionals under 40 who are shaping sustainability strategy and execution within India's leading enterprises. The felicitation runs alongside a day of panel discussions and case studies from sustainability leaders at organisations including Reliance Industries, Axis Bank, Cipla, ICICI Bank, HCLTech, Aditya Birla Group, Godrej Industries Group, JSW Group and Siemens, set against the theme “From Ambition to Advantage.”

The day will close with the BW Sustainable World Awards 2026, honouring organisations and leaders for measurable impact across corporate sustainability, following a keynote from Deepak Thakur, MD & CEO, Hinduja Renewables, on scaling sustainable leadership as growth outpaces the broader ecosystem. The awards ceremony will be followed by a celebratory dinner for attendees.

The conclave's opening address, "Sustainability Beyond Action," will be delivered by Dr. Annurag Batra, Chairman & Editor-in-Chief, BW Businessworld and Founder, Exchange4Media, who will speak to the platform's decade-long effort in recognising sustainability leadership and innovation across India Inc.

The 40 Under 40 and Sustainable World Awards platforms have, over previous editions, recognised young sustainability leaders and pioneering organisations for measurable contributions to India's climate and sustainability goals, cementing BW Businessworld's role as a platform that identifies and champions emerging leadership in this space.

BW Businessworldis one of India's leading business media platforms, publishing incisive journalism and hosting flagship industry conclaves and award platforms across sectors including sustainability, technology and entrepreneurship.
